title.en: SAT R&W: Boundaries — extra information in pairs
title.uz: SAT R&W: Boundaries — qoʻshimcha maʼlumot va juft belgilar
title.ru: SAT R&W: Boundaries — дополнительная информация и парные знаки

body.en:
Some parts of a sentence only add extra information. Lift the part out: if what is left is still a full sentence with the same meaning, the part is extra.
An extra part is closed off by a matching pair of marks:
• two commas: Our school's oldest tree, a tall walnut, shades the whole yard.
• two dashes: Our school's oldest tree—a tall walnut—shades the whole yard.
• two parentheses: Our school's oldest tree (a tall walnut) shades the whole yard.
The mark that opens the part must also close it: never a dash on one side and a comma on the other.
At the start or the end of a sentence one mark is enough, because the capital letter or the full stop is the other side:
"A tall walnut, the tree is older than the school."
"The yard has one old tree, a tall walnut."
body.uz:
Gapning baʼzi qismlari faqat qoʻshimcha maʼlumot beradi. Shu qismni olib tashlang: qolgani hamon toʻliq gap boʻlsa va maʼnosi oʻzgarmasa, bu qism qoʻshimcha.
Qoʻshimcha qism bir xil juft belgilar bilan ajratiladi:
• ikki vergul: Our school’s oldest tree, a tall walnut, shades the whole yard.
• ikki tire: Our school’s oldest tree—a tall walnut—shades the whole yard.
• ikki qavs: Our school’s oldest tree (a tall walnut) shades the whole yard.
Qismni qaysi belgi ochgan boʻlsa, oʻsha belgi yopadi: bir tomonda tire, ikkinchi tomonda vergul boʻlmaydi.
Gap boshida yoki oxirida bitta belgi yetadi, chunki ikkinchi tomon — bosh harf yoki nuqta:
«A tall walnut, the tree is older than the school.»
«The yard has one old tree, a tall walnut.»
body.ru:
Некоторые части предложения только добавляют сведения. Уберите такую часть: если остаётся полное предложение с тем же смыслом, эта часть дополнительная.
Дополнительную часть выделяют парой одинаковых знаков:
• две запятые: Our school's oldest tree, a tall walnut, shades the whole yard.
• два тире: Our school's oldest tree—a tall walnut—shades the whole yard.
• две скобки: Our school's oldest tree (a tall walnut) shades the whole yard.
Каким знаком часть открыта, таким она и закрывается: не бывает тире с одной стороны и запятой с другой.
В начале или в конце предложения достаточно одного знака, потому что другую сторону закрывает заглавная буква или точка:
«A tall walnut, the tree is older than the school.»
«The yard has one old tree, a tall walnut.»

body.en:
Worked example: "Aziza's first robot (a small car made from a shoebox and two old ______ won a prize at the school fair."
Step 1: Find where the extra part opens: the parenthesis before "a small car".
Step 2: Lift the part out: "Aziza's first robot won a prize at the school fair." That is still a full sentence, so the part is extra.
Step 3: A parenthesis opened it, so a parenthesis closes it: "motors)".
Now you: "The library's reading room, a quiet space with twelve long ______ stays open until eight on weekdays."
Step 1: The extra part opens with the comma after "room".
Step 2: Lift it out: "The library's reading room stays open until eight on weekdays."
Step 3: Which mark closes the part after "tables"?
body.uz:
Namuna: «Aziza’s first robot (a small car made from a shoebox and two old ______ won a prize at the school fair.»
1-qadam: qoʻshimcha qism qayerda ochilganini toping: «a small car» oldidagi qavs.
2-qadam: shu qismni olib tashlang: «Aziza’s first robot won a prize at the school fair.» Bu hamon toʻliq gap, demak, qism qoʻshimcha.
3-qadam: uni qavs ochgan, shuning uchun qavs yopadi: «motors)».
Endi siz: «The library’s reading room, a quiet space with twelve long ______ stays open until eight on weekdays.»
1-qadam: qoʻshimcha qism «room» dan keyingi vergul bilan ochiladi.
2-qadam: uni olib tashlang: «The library’s reading room stays open until eight on weekdays.»
3-qadam: «tables» dan keyin qismni qaysi belgi yopadi?
body.ru:
Пример: «Aziza's first robot (a small car made from a shoebox and two old ______ won a prize at the school fair.»
Шаг 1: найдите, где открывается дополнительная часть: скобка перед «a small car».
Шаг 2: уберите эту часть: «Aziza's first robot won a prize at the school fair.» Это всё ещё полное предложение, значит, часть дополнительная.
Шаг 3: её открыла скобка, значит, и закрывает скобка: «motors)».
Теперь попробуйте сами: «The library's reading room, a quiet space with twelve long ______ stays open until eight on weekdays.»
Шаг 1: дополнительная часть открывается запятой после «room».
Шаг 2: уберите её: «The library's reading room stays open until eight on weekdays.»
Шаг 3: какой знак закрывает часть после «tables»?

body.en:
Watch out: some parts look extra but are essential, so they take no marks at all.
• A job word used like a title right before a name: "Last year, chess coach Anvar Rahimov chose the team." Lift out the name and "Last year, chess coach chose the team" is broken, so the name is not extra: no commas.
• A name that picks out one of several: "My cousin Jasur plays the doira" means I have more than one cousin. Write "My cousin, Jasur, plays the doira" only if I have just one.
• A that-part is always essential and never takes commas. An extra part about a thing starts with which: "The bus, which is new, is late."
Then check where the pair closes: lift out only what is between the two marks. If what is left is not a full sentence, one of the marks is in the wrong place.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: baʼzi qismlar qoʻshimchaga oʻxshaydi, lekin ular zarur, shuning uchun hech qanday belgi bilan ajratilmaydi.
• Ism oldidan unvon kabi kelgan kasb nomi: «Last year, chess coach Anvar Rahimov chose the team.» Ismni olib tashlasangiz, «Last year, chess coach chose the team» buziladi, demak, ism qoʻshimcha emas: vergul qoʻyilmaydi.
• Bir nechtadan bittasini ajratib koʻrsatadigan ism: «My cousin Jasur plays the doira» — mening bir nechta amakivachcham bor degani. «My cousin, Jasur, plays the doira» faqat bitta amakivachcham boʻlsa yoziladi.
• That bilan boshlangan qism doim zarur va hech qachon vergul olmaydi. Narsa haqidagi qoʻshimcha qism which bilan boshlanadi: «The bus, which is new, is late.»
Soʻng juft qayerda yopilishini tekshiring: faqat ikki belgi orasidagini olib tashlang. Qolgani toʻliq gap boʻlmasa, belgilardan biri notoʻgʻri joyda.
body.ru:
Осторожно: некоторые части похожи на дополнительные, но они необходимы, поэтому их ничем не выделяют.
• Название профессии перед именем, как звание: «Last year, chess coach Anvar Rahimov chose the team.» Уберите имя — «Last year, chess coach chose the team» — и предложение сломается, значит, имя не дополнительное: запятых нет.
• Имя, которое выделяет одного из нескольких: «My cousin Jasur plays the doira» значит, что у меня несколько двоюродных братьев. «My cousin, Jasur, plays the doira» пишут, только если он один.
• Часть с that всегда необходима и никогда не выделяется запятыми. Дополнительная часть о предмете начинается с which: «The bus, which is new, is late.»
Затем проверьте, где закрывается пара: уберите только то, что между двумя знаками. Если остаток — не полное предложение, один из знаков стоит не там.

title.en: SAT R&W: Boundaries — joining words, colons and dashes
title.uz: SAT R&W: Boundaries — bogʻlovchi soʻzlar, ikki nuqta va tire
title.ru: SAT R&W: Boundaries — связующие слова, двоеточие и тире

body.en:
Two kinds of joining words stand between complete sentences, and they take different marks.
• and, but, or, so, yet: a comma before the word is enough. "The shop was closed, so we went home."
• however, therefore, nevertheless, instead, as a result, for example, in fact, by contrast, meanwhile: these cannot join two sentences alone. Put a semicolon or a full stop before the word and a comma after it: "The shop was closed; however, the café next door was open."
To place the marks, find where the first sentence ends. The semicolon goes there, and the comma goes after the joining word.
Inside one sentence, such a word takes a comma on each side: "The café, however, closed at six."
A colon or a single dash can join two parts when the second explains the first or names what the first promised: "We had one problem: the bus was late." The part before the colon must be a complete sentence.
body.uz:
Toʻliq gaplar orasida ikki xil bogʻlovchi soʻz keladi va ular har xil belgi talab qiladi.
• and, but, or, so, yet: soʻz oldidan vergul yetarli. «The shop was closed, so we went home.»
• however, therefore, nevertheless, instead, as a result, for example, in fact, by contrast, meanwhile: ular ikki gapni yolgʻiz bogʻlay olmaydi. Soʻz oldidan nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta, undan keyin vergul qoʻying: «The shop was closed; however, the café next door was open.»
Belgilarni qoʻyish uchun birinchi gap qayerda tugashini toping. Nuqtali vergul oʻsha yerga, vergul esa bogʻlovchi soʻzdan keyin qoʻyiladi.
Bitta gap ichida bunday soʻz ikki tomonidan vergul oladi: «The café, however, closed at six.»
Ikki nuqta yoki bitta tire ikki qismni bogʻlay oladi, agar ikkinchi qism birinchisini tushuntirsa yoki birinchisi vaʼda qilgan narsani aytsa: «We had one problem: the bus was late.» Ikki nuqtadan oldingi qism toʻliq gap boʻlishi kerak.
body.ru:
Между полными предложениями стоят связующие слова двух видов, и знаки у них разные.
• and, but, or, so, yet: достаточно запятой перед словом. «The shop was closed, so we went home.»
• however, therefore, nevertheless, instead, as a result, for example, in fact, by contrast, meanwhile: сами по себе они не соединяют два предложения. Перед словом ставьте точку с запятой или точку, после него — запятую: «The shop was closed; however, the café next door was open.»
Чтобы расставить знаки, найдите, где кончается первое предложение. Точка с запятой ставится там, а запятая — после связующего слова.
Внутри одного предложения такое слово выделяется запятыми с двух сторон: «The café, however, closed at six.»
Двоеточие или одно тире соединяют две части, если вторая объясняет первую или называет то, что первая обещала: «We had one problem: the bus was late.» Часть перед двоеточием должна быть полным предложением.

body.en:
Worked example: "The first bus to the lake was full. The class waited for the second bus, which was almost ______ everyone found a seat."
Step 1: Find where the first sentence ends: "The class waited for the second bus, which was almost empty" is complete.
Step 2: The rest, "everyone found a seat", is complete too, so two sentences meet at the blank.
Step 3: "Therefore" shows the result, so it belongs to the second sentence: a semicolon before it and a comma after it, "empty; therefore,".
Now you: "Saodat could not print her ticket at ______ she showed the code on her phone at the gate."
Step 1: "Saodat could not print her ticket at home" is complete.
Step 2: "she showed the code on her phone at the gate" is complete too.
Step 3: "Instead" belongs to the second sentence. Where do the semicolon and the comma go?
body.uz:
Namuna: «The first bus to the lake was full. The class waited for the second bus, which was almost ______ everyone found a seat.»
1-qadam: birinchi gap qayerda tugashini toping: «The class waited for the second bus, which was almost empty» — toʻliq.
2-qadam: qolgan qism, «everyone found a seat», ham toʻliq, demak, boʻsh joyda ikki gap tutashadi.
3-qadam: «Therefore» natijani bildiradi, shuning uchun u ikkinchi gapga tegishli: oldidan nuqtali vergul, keyin vergul — «empty; therefore,».
Endi siz: «Saodat could not print her ticket at ______ she showed the code on her phone at the gate.»
1-qadam: «Saodat could not print her ticket at home» — toʻliq.
2-qadam: «she showed the code on her phone at the gate» ham toʻliq.
3-qadam: «Instead» ikkinchi gapga tegishli. Nuqtali vergul va vergul qayerga qoʻyiladi?
body.ru:
Пример: «The first bus to the lake was full. The class waited for the second bus, which was almost ______ everyone found a seat.»
Шаг 1: найдите, где кончается первое предложение: «The class waited for the second bus, which was almost empty» — полное.
Шаг 2: остаток, «everyone found a seat», тоже полный, значит, в пропуске встречаются два предложения.
Шаг 3: «Therefore» показывает результат, поэтому относится ко второму предложению: перед ним точка с запятой, после — запятая, «empty; therefore,».
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Saodat could not print her ticket at ______ she showed the code on her phone at the gate.»
Шаг 1: «Saodat could not print her ticket at home» — полное.
Шаг 2: «she showed the code on her phone at the gate» — тоже полное.
Шаг 3: «Instead» относится ко второму предложению. Где стоят точка с запятой и запятая?

body.en:
Watch out: the joining word can move into the second sentence. Then the semicolon still goes where the first sentence ends, and the word takes a comma on each side:
"Most of the class walked to the museum; Aziz and Madina, however, took the bus."
So never trust the word's position. Find the end of the first sentence first.
One more: a colon or a dash needs a complete sentence before it, but what comes after can be a single word or a list: "Only one thing was missing: the key." A colon never follows such as, including or a verb like are: "The colors are: red and blue" is wrong.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: bogʻlovchi soʻz ikkinchi gap ichiga koʻchishi mumkin. Unda ham nuqtali vergul birinchi gap tugagan joyga qoʻyiladi, soʻz esa ikki tomonidan vergul oladi:
«Most of the class walked to the museum; Aziz and Madina, however, took the bus.»
Shuning uchun soʻzning joyiga ishonmang. Avval birinchi gapning oxirini toping.
Yana bittasi: ikki nuqta yoki tiredan oldin toʻliq gap kerak, keyin esa bitta soʻz yoki roʻyxat kelishi mumkin: «Only one thing was missing: the key.» Ikki nuqta such as yoki including dan keyin ham, are kabi feʼldan keyin ham qoʻyilmaydi: «The colors are: red and blue» — xato.
body.ru:
Осторожно: связующее слово может переместиться внутрь второго предложения. Точка с запятой всё равно ставится там, где кончается первое предложение, а слово выделяется запятыми с двух сторон:
«Most of the class walked to the museum; Aziz and Madina, however, took the bus.»
Поэтому не доверяйте месту слова. Сначала найдите конец первого предложения.
И ещё: перед двоеточием или тире нужно полное предложение, а после может стоять одно слово или список: «Only one thing was missing: the key.» Двоеточие не ставится после such as, including или глагола вроде are: «The colors are: red and blue» — ошибка.

title.en: SAT R&W: Form, Structure and Sense — verb form and tense
title.uz: SAT R&W: Form, Structure and Sense — feʼl shakli va zamoni
title.ru: SAT R&W: Form, Structure and Sense — форма и время глагола

body.en:
Every sentence needs a main verb: a verb that shows the time, such as walks, walked, has walked, will walk or was built.
A word ending in -ing (walking) or a to-form (to walk) cannot be the main verb on its own. "The children, tired after the long trip, sleeping on the bus" has no main verb: write "slept".
Then match the tense to the time words:
• since or for + a time up to now: has or have + the past participle. "She has lived here since March."
• an action going on when something else happened: was or were + -ing. "We were eating when the lights went out."
• before another past action: had + the past participle. "The film had started when we arrived."
• by a time in the future: will have + the past participle. "By June, he will have finished the course."
Last, ask who does the action. If the subject does it, use the active form: "The class painted the wall." If the subject receives it, use be + the past participle: "The wall was painted."
body.uz:
Har bir gapga asosiy feʼl kerak: zamonni koʻrsatadigan feʼl, masalan walks, walked, has walked, will walk yoki was built.
-ing bilan tugagan soʻz (walking) yoki to-shakl (to walk) yolgʻiz oʻzi asosiy feʼl boʻla olmaydi. «The children, tired after the long trip, sleeping on the bus» — asosiy feʼl yoʻq: «slept» deb yozing.
Keyin zamonni vaqt soʻzlariga moslang:
• since yoki for + hozirgacha davom etgan vaqt: has yoki have + past participle. «She has lived here since March.»
• boshqa ish yuz berganda davom etayotgan ish: was yoki were + -ing. «We were eating when the lights went out.»
• boshqa oʻtgan ishdan oldingi ish: had + past participle. «The film had started when we arrived.»
• kelajakdagi vaqtgacha: will have + past participle. «By June, he will have finished the course.»
Oxirida ishni kim bajarishini aniqlang. Ega bajarsa — aniq nisbat: «The class painted the wall.» Ega ish taʼsirini olsa — be + past participle: «The wall was painted.»
body.ru:
В каждом предложении нужен главный глагол — глагол, который показывает время: walks, walked, has walked, will walk или was built.
Слово на -ing (walking) или форма с to (to walk) сами по себе не могут быть главным глаголом. «The children, tired after the long trip, sleeping on the bus» — главного глагола нет: пишите «slept».
Затем согласуйте время со словами времени:
• since или for + время, длящееся до сих пор: has или have + past participle. «She has lived here since March.»
• действие шло, когда случилось другое: was или were + -ing. «We were eating when the lights went out.»
• действие раньше другого прошлого действия: had + past participle. «The film had started when we arrived.»
• к моменту в будущем: will have + past participle. «By June, he will have finished the course.»
Наконец, спросите себя, кто совершает действие. Если его совершает подлежащее — действительный залог: «The class painted the wall.» Если действие направлено на подлежащее — be + past participle: «The wall was painted.»

body.en:
Worked example: "Malika ______ the violin since she was seven, and now she plays in the city youth orchestra."
Step 1: Find the time words: "since she was seven" runs from the past up to now.
Step 2: Since + a time up to now takes has or have + the past participle.
Step 3: Malika is one person, so "has played", not "played" or "is playing".
Now you: "Our neighbors ______ in the same apartment for twenty years, and they know everyone in the building."
Step 1: Find the time words: "for twenty years", up to now.
Step 2: For + a time up to now takes has or have + the past participle.
Step 3: "Neighbors" are several people. Which verb fits?
body.uz:
Namuna: «Malika ______ the violin since she was seven, and now she plays in the city youth orchestra.»
1-qadam: vaqt soʻzlarini toping: «since she was seven» — oʻtmishdan hozirgacha.
2-qadam: since + hozirgacha davom etgan vaqt has yoki have + past participle talab qiladi.
3-qadam: Malika — bitta odam, shuning uchun «has played», «played» yoki «is playing» emas.
Endi siz: «Our neighbors ______ in the same apartment for twenty years, and they know everyone in the building.»
1-qadam: vaqt soʻzlarini toping: «for twenty years» — hozirgacha.
2-qadam: for + hozirgacha davom etgan vaqt has yoki have + past participle talab qiladi.
3-qadam: «Neighbors» — bir nechta odam. Qaysi feʼl mos keladi?
body.ru:
Пример: «Malika ______ the violin since she was seven, and now she plays in the city youth orchestra.»
Шаг 1: найдите слова времени: «since she was seven» — с прошлого до сих пор.
Шаг 2: since + время, длящееся до сих пор, требует has или have + past participle.
Шаг 3: Малика — один человек, поэтому «has played», а не «played» и не «is playing».
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Our neighbors ______ in the same apartment for twenty years, and they know everyone in the building.»
Шаг 1: найдите слова времени: «for twenty years» — до сих пор.
Шаг 2: for + время, длящееся до сих пор, требует has или have + past participle.
Шаг 3: «Neighbors» — несколько человек. Какой глагол подходит?

body.en:
Watch out for two traps.
• After be, has, have and had, use the past participle, not the past simple: "The letters were written by hand", never "were wrote"; "has begun" and "had taken", never "has began" or "had took".
• A long sentence can hide a missing verb: "The bridge that the workers finished last year, after months of delays" is not yet a sentence. Cover the extra parts and look for the verb that goes with the subject.
So ask two questions: does the subject have a main verb? Is the verb's form right for the time and for who does the action?
body.uz:
Ikki tuzoqdan ehtiyot boʻling.
• Be, has, have va had dan keyin past simple emas, past participle ishlatiladi: «The letters were written by hand», hech qachon «were wrote» emas; «has begun» va «had taken», hech qachon «has began» yoki «had took» emas.
• Uzun gap tushib qolgan feʼlni yashirishi mumkin: «The bridge that the workers finished last year, after months of delays» — bu hali gap emas. Qoʻshimcha qismlarni yopib, egaga tegishli feʼlni qidiring.
Demak, oʻzingizga ikki savol bering: eganing asosiy feʼli bormi? Feʼl shakli vaqtga va ishni kim bajarishiga mosmi?
body.ru:
Осторожно, две ловушки.
• После be, has, have и had нужен past participle, а не past simple: «The letters were written by hand», а не «were wrote»; «has begun» и «had taken», а не «has began» или «had took».
• Длинное предложение может скрыть, что глагола нет: «The bridge that the workers finished last year, after months of delays» — это ещё не предложение. Закройте дополнительные части и найдите глагол подлежащего.
Итак, задайте два вопроса: есть ли у подлежащего главный глагол? Подходит ли его форма ко времени и к тому, кто совершает действие?

title.en: SAT R&W: Form, Structure and Sense — pronouns and possessives
title.uz: SAT R&W: Form, Structure and Sense — olmoshlar va egalik shakllari
title.ru: SAT R&W: Form, Structure and Sense — местоимения и притяжательные формы

body.en:
A pronoun takes the number of the noun it stands for.
• One thing or one group: it, its. A team, a class, a club, a council or a company is one group: "The club changed its name."
• Each, every and one of count as one too: "Each of the rooms has its own key."
• Several: they, their.
Words that sound alike but mean different things:
• their = belonging to them; there = in that place, or "there is"; they're = they are.
• its = belonging to it; it's = it is or it has.
• whose = belonging to whom, for people and things; who's = who is or who has.
A possessive pronoun never takes an apostrophe: its, hers, ours, theirs.
Owners: one student's bag; two students' bags. A plural without s takes 's: the children's books, the people's choice.
body.uz:
Olmosh oʻzi oʻrnini bosgan otning soniga moslashadi.
• Bitta narsa yoki bitta guruh: it, its. Team, class, club, council yoki company — bitta guruh: «The club changed its name.»
• Each, every va one of ham bitta hisoblanadi: «Each of the rooms has its own key.»
• Bir nechta: they, their.
Talaffuzi oʻxshash, maʼnosi har xil soʻzlar:
• their — ularning; there — u yerda yoki «there is»; they’re — they are.
• its — uning; it’s — it is yoki it has.
• whose — kimning yoki nimaning, odam va narsa uchun; who’s — who is yoki who has.
Egalik olmoshi hech qachon apostrof olmaydi: its, hers, ours, theirs.
Egalik: one student’s bag; two students’ bags. s bilan tugamaydigan koʻplik ’s oladi: the children’s books, the people’s choice.
body.ru:
Местоимение согласуется в числе с существительным, которое оно заменяет.
• Один предмет или одна группа: it, its. Team, class, club, council или company — одна группа: «The club changed its name.»
• После each, every и one of тоже нужно единственное число: «Each of the rooms has its own key.»
• Несколько: they, their.
Слова, которые звучат похоже, но значат разное:
• their — их; there — там или «there is»; they're — they are.
• its — его, её (о предмете); it's — it is или it has.
• whose — чей, о людях и о предметах; who's — who is или who has.
Притяжательное местоимение никогда не пишется с апострофом: its, hers, ours, theirs.
Притяжательная форма: one student's bag; two students' bags. Множественное число без s получает 's: the children's books, the people's choice.

body.en:
Worked example: "The two ______ gardens are side by side, and both are full of roses in June."
Step 1: Is there an owner? Yes: the gardens belong to someone.
Step 2: How many owners? "The two" means two neighbors, a plural that ends in s.
Step 3: A plural that ends in s takes only an apostrophe: "neighbors'".
Now you: "All three of my ______ paintings now hang in the hall next to the school library, where everyone can see them."
Step 1: Is there an owner? Yes: the paintings belong to someone.
Step 2: "All three" means several cousins, a plural that ends in s.
Step 3: Which form shows that several cousins own the paintings?
body.uz:
Namuna: «The two ______ gardens are side by side, and both are full of roses in June.»
1-qadam: bogʻlarning egasi bormi? Ha: ular kimgadir tegishli.
2-qadam: egasi nechta? «The two» — ikki qoʻshni, s bilan tugaydigan koʻplik.
3-qadam: s bilan tugaydigan koʻplik faqat apostrof oladi: «neighbors’».
Endi siz: «All three of my ______ paintings now hang in the hall next to the school library, where everyone can see them.»
1-qadam: rasmlarning egasi bormi? Ha: ular kimgadir tegishli.
2-qadam: «All three» — bir nechta amakivachcha, s bilan tugaydigan koʻplik.
3-qadam: rasmlar bir nechta amakivachchaga tegishli ekanini qaysi shakl koʻrsatadi?
body.ru:
Пример: «The two ______ gardens are side by side, and both are full of roses in June.»
Шаг 1: есть ли владелец? Да: сады кому-то принадлежат.
Шаг 2: сколько владельцев? «The two» — два соседа, множественное число на s.
Шаг 3: множественное число на s получает только апостроф: «neighbors'».
Теперь попробуйте сами: «All three of my ______ paintings now hang in the hall next to the school library, where everyone can see them.»
Шаг 1: есть ли владелец? Да: картины кому-то принадлежат.
Шаг 2: «All three» — несколько двоюродных братьев, множественное число на s.
Шаг 3: какая форма показывает, что картины принадлежат нескольким двоюродным братьям?

body.en:
Watch out: the noun right before the pronoun is often not the one it stands for.
"The box of old coins that my grandparents keep in the cupboard has lost its lid." Whose lid? The box's. One box, so "its", even though "coins" and "grandparents" are closer.
Put the noun in the pronoun's place and read again: "the box's lid" makes sense; "the grandparents' lid" does not.
And do not add an apostrophe just because a word ends in s: "the players' shirts" (the players own the shirts), but "the players ran" (no owner, no apostrophe).
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: olmoshdan oldingi ot koʻpincha u oʻrnini bosgan ot emas.
«The box of old coins that my grandparents keep in the cupboard has lost its lid.» Kimning qopqogʻi? Qutining. Quti bitta, shuning uchun «its», garchi «coins» va «grandparents» yaqinroq boʻlsa ham.
Olmosh oʻrniga otni qoʻyib, qayta oʻqing: «the box’s lid» maʼnoli, «the grandparents’ lid» esa yoʻq.
Soʻz s bilan tugagani uchungina apostrof qoʻymang: «the players’ shirts» (futbolkalar oʻyinchilarniki), lekin «the players ran» (egalik yoʻq, apostrof yoʻq).
body.ru:
Осторожно: существительное прямо перед местоимением часто не то, которое оно заменяет.
«The box of old coins that my grandparents keep in the cupboard has lost its lid.» Чья крышка? Коробки. Коробка одна, поэтому «its», хотя «coins» и «grandparents» стоят ближе.
Подставьте существительное на место местоимения и прочитайте снова: «the box's lid» имеет смысл, а «the grandparents' lid» — нет.
И не ставьте апостроф только потому, что слово оканчивается на s: «the players' shirts» (футболки принадлежат игрокам), но «the players ran» (здесь ничего никому не принадлежит, апостроф не нужен).

stem.en:
The town's summer market—open every Saturday from June to ______ sells fruit, bread, and handmade toys in the square by the river.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: A dash opens the extra part after "market", so a dash must close it: "August—". A comma would leave the pair unmatched.
why.uz: Qoʻshimcha qismni «market» dan keyingi tire ochgan, shuning uchun uni tire yopadi: «August—». Vergul juftni buzadi.
why.ru: Дополнительную часть открывает тире после «market», значит, закрыть её должно тире: «August—». Запятая нарушит пару.

stem.en:
The library's reading room, a quiet space with twelve long ______ stays open until eight on weekdays.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: A comma after "room" opens the extra part, so a comma closes it: "tables,". A dash would not match, and no mark leaves it open.
why.uz: Qoʻshimcha qismni «room» dan keyingi vergul ochgan, shuning uchun uni vergul yopadi: «tables,». Tire mos kelmaydi, belgisiz qism ochiq qoladi.
why.ru: Запятая после «room» открывает дополнительную часть, поэтому закрывает её запятая: «tables,». Тире не совпадает, а без знака часть не закрыта.

stem.en:
Last spring, ______ opened a small pottery workshop near the old bazaar, where she now teaches weekend classes to children.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: "Potter" works like a title before the name, and without the name "potter opened" is broken, so no commas: "potter Malika Tosheva".
why.uz: «Potter» ism oldida unvon kabi turibdi; ismsiz «potter opened» buziladi, shuning uchun vergul yoʻq: «potter Malika Tosheva».
why.ru: «Potter» стоит перед именем как звание; без имени «potter opened» ломается, поэтому запятых нет: «potter Malika Tosheva».

stem.en:
Bobur left his umbrella at ______ he walked home in the rain and arrived soaked.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: "Bobur left his umbrella at school" is a full sentence and "as a result" begins the next, so: "school; as a result,".
why.uz: «Bobur left his umbrella at school» — toʻliq gap, «as a result» keyingi gapni boshlaydi, shuning uchun: «school; as a result,».
why.ru: «Bobur left his umbrella at school» — полное предложение, а «as a result» начинает следующее, поэтому: «school; as a result,».

stem.en:
Saodat could not print her ticket at ______ she showed the code on her phone at the gate.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: Both sides are full sentences and "instead" begins the second, so the semicolon goes before it and the comma after: "home; instead,".
why.uz: Ikki tomon ham toʻliq gap, «instead» ikkinchisini boshlaydi: nuqtali vergul undan oldin, vergul keyin — «home; instead,».
why.ru: Обе части — полные предложения, и «instead» начинает второе: точка с запятой перед ним, запятая после — «home; instead,».

stem.en:
Most of the volunteers went home right after the ______ however, stayed behind to stack the chairs and sweep the hall.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The first sentence ends at "concert": semicolon there. "However" sits inside the second, with commas on both sides: "concert; Jasur and his sister,".
why.uz: Birinchi gap «concert» da tugaydi, nuqtali vergul oʻsha yerda; «however» ikkinchi gap ichida, ikki tomonida vergul: «concert; Jasur and his sister,».
why.ru: Первое предложение кончается на «concert», там точка с запятой; «however» внутри второго, с запятыми по обе стороны: «concert; Jasur and his sister,».

stem.en:
The new students from the village school, shy on their first morning in the big city, ______ quietly at the back of the classroom.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The subject "the new students" has no verb yet, and an -ing or to-form cannot be the main verb, so "sat".
why.uz: «The new students» egasining hali feʼli yoʻq, -ing yoki to-shakl esa asosiy feʼl boʻla olmaydi, shuning uchun «sat».
why.ru: У подлежащего «the new students» ещё нет глагола, а форма на -ing или с to не может быть главным глаголом, поэтому «sat».

stem.en:
Our neighbors ______ in the same apartment for twenty years, and they know everyone in the building.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: "For twenty years" runs up to now, so has or have + past participle; "neighbors" are several, so "have lived".
why.uz: «For twenty years» hozirgacha davom etadi, demak, has yoki have + past participle; «neighbors» — bir nechta, shuning uchun «have lived».
why.ru: «For twenty years» — до сих пор, значит, has или have + past participle; «neighbors» — несколько, поэтому «have lived».

stem.en:
The bright patterns on the walls of the new metro station ______ by students from the city's art college during the summer holidays.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The patterns did not draw; they received the action, so be + past participle: "were drawn". "Drew" is the past simple, and "drawn" alone is no main verb.
why.uz: Naqshlar chizmagan, ularni chizishgan, shuning uchun be + past participle: «were drawn». «Drew» — past simple, yolgʻiz «drawn» esa asosiy feʼl emas.
why.ru: Узоры не рисовали сами — их нарисовали, поэтому be + past participle: «were drawn». «Drew» — past simple, а одно «drawn» — не главный глагол.

stem.en:
The two new students in our class say that ______ looking forward to the school trip to the mountains next week.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The blank needs "they are": the students are looking forward to the trip, so "they're". "Their" means belonging to them; "there" is a place.
why.uz: Boʻsh joyga «they are» kerak: oʻquvchilar sayohatni intiqlik bilan kutmoqda, shuning uchun «they’re». «Their» — ularning, «there» — joy.
why.ru: В пропуске нужно «they are»: ученики с нетерпением ждут поездки, поэтому «they're». «Their» — «их», «there» — «там».

stem.en:
The collection of paintings that the students made during their trip to the mountains will have ______ own room in the school museum next year.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: Whose room? The collection's, one thing, so "its", even though "paintings" and "students" are closer to the blank.
why.uz: Kimning xonasi? Toʻplamning — bitta narsa, shuning uchun «its», garchi «paintings» va «students» boʻsh joyga yaqinroq boʻlsa ham.
why.ru: Чья комната? Коллекции, а коллекция — одно целое, поэтому «its», хотя «paintings» и «students» ближе к пропуску.
